label: YARA editor: external checks
description: Extra checks of the YARA editor, next to Rulezet's own validation (which alone decides whether a rule can be saved): yarax = YARA-X diagnostics and formatter, cccs = CCCS YARA metadata standard, yaraqa = yaraQA logic / performance advice. true = offered in the editor (Check button and the 'External checks' step of Create, never blocking).
